name: Surgical Neck Fracture of Humerus
definition: Fracture through the surgical neck region of the proximal humerus, common in older adults after low-energy falls.

investigations.principle: Radiographs establish diagnosis; CT is used for complex fracture patterns.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery depends on displacement, fracture pattern, bone quality and patient function.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern fracture planning.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture through the surgical neck region of the proximal humerus, common in older adults after low-energy falls.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
